skill.name: bid-on-ltv
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to set up customer lifetime value bidding in Google Ads, Meta, or ChatGPT Ads. Compare revenue and profit signals from observed paid orders, check setup status, and review the conversion settings you need to select.
skill.summary: Set up ad bidding with revenue or profit from observed customer orders.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance alerts and most backtick and URL alerts were false positives. The consequential matches concern order-level data access, remote MCP execution, and an unpinned installer. The workflow also lacks safeguards for direct credential handling, approval before writes, and mutable setup instructions.

remediation.issue: The assistant can receive and forward raw integration credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Require browser-based authorization or vendor-managed secret entry. Accept only an opaque credential reference in assistant tool calls and redact secrets from tool output.

remediation.issue: Setup writes do not require explicit approval for the chosen account and changes.
remediation.suggestion: Default to read-only checks. Show the target store, ad account, and proposed changes, then get explicit approval before applying those changes.

remediation.issue: Live vendor pages can supply steps for authenticated workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a reviewed, versioned guide or pin remote instructions to a reviewed revision. Treat fetched text as reference material and validate tool actions against approved operations.

remediation.issue: Verification can fetch unnecessary order-level details.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a status summary or a user-selected test order. Return only the fields needed to verify the conversion and avoid displaying customer details.

remediation.issue: The installation example does not pin the installer or the skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Document a reviewed installer version and an immutable skill revision. Make installation an explicit user action.

remediation.issue: The workflow directs agents to a hosted MCP execution interface.
remediation.suggestion: Use an explicitly configured and trusted MCP connection with account-scoped permissions. Restrict execution to the approved operations.

content.user_title: Set Up Bidding on Customer Lifetime Value
content.value_statement: The first purchase does not show how much a repeat customer has spent over time. Use Product Metrics to prepare revenue or profit conversion signals from observed paid orders.
actual_capabilities: Explains how Product Metrics calculates revenue and profit from observed paid orders.
Checks setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP and identifies completed and pending steps.
Finds setup guidance for Shopify, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, Magento, Shopware, and sites on Cloudflare.
Identifies the revenue and profit conversion names for Google Ads, Meta, and ChatGPT Ads.
Guides users through selecting an optimization conversion and checking its status after the change.
limitations: Lifetime value is historical, not predictive. Product Metrics does not import orders from before the connection.
Unrecognized customers and unpaid orders do not contribute. Profit lifetime value requires known costs.
Conversion delivery depends on the channel's consent and matching requirements.
A person must make the Google Ads action primary or select the optimization conversion in Meta or ChatGPT Ads.

use_cases.title: Choose a bidding metric
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit signals before choosing what your campaigns should optimize for.

use_cases.title: Plan a Google Ads conversion change
use_cases.description: Check whether the lifetime value actions exist and identify which campaign settings you need to change manually.

use_cases.description: Compare customer matching, consent, and currency requirements before handing off a Meta or ChatGPT Ads setup.

prompt_templates.title: Explain lifetime value bidding
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain customer lifetime value bidding in plain language. Compare it with bidding on the first order and explain which orders count.
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn the basics before connecting an ad account.

prompt_templates.title: Choose revenue or profit
prompt_templates.prompt: I run a Shopify store and have not configured product costs. Recommend a lifetime value signal and list what I need before switching to profit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a bidding signal while cost data is incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Check Google Ads readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Product Metrics setup for my WooCommerce store and Google Ads without changing anything. List the completed steps and what I need to do manually.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing integration before selecting an optimization conversion.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a cross-channel rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a rollout plan for profit lifetime value on Meta and ChatGPT Ads. Compare event values, cost and consent requirements, test checks, and manual steps. Do not change settings or request credentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a review before enabling bidding on profit.

output_examples.input: An identified customer pays 108 euros and later pays 64 euros. What revenue value does each channel receive?
output_examples.output: Google Ads, Meta, and ChatGPT Ads receive 108 euros for the first order and 64 euros for the second. Meta also receives the running total of 172 euros on the second order.

output_examples.input: My Google Ads revenue action is secondary and my cost data is incomplete. What should I do next?
output: Use Revenue LTV while cost data is incomplete.
Verify that the new action records conversions while it is secondary.
When ready to switch, make the revenue LTV action primary and the old purchase action secondary yourself.

output_examples.input: Why did lifetime value restart when a guest created an account?
output_examples.output: Product Metrics uses the customer account ID instead of the guest email after the switch. Purchases under the guest key do not carry over to the account total.

best_practices: Start with a read-only status check and verify the store and advertising account before approving changes.
Keep Google Ads actions secondary until you verify the conversion signal and are ready to change optimization.
Check consent, customer matching, and cost coverage before relying on profit lifetime value.
anti_patterns: Treating observed lifetime value as a forecast or assuming it includes orders from before the connection.
Switching to profit bidding before order costs are available.
Pasting API keys or access tokens into the assistant conversation.

faq.question: Which advertising channels does the skill cover?
faq.answer: The skill covers Google Ads conversion actions and custom conversion events for Meta and ChatGPT Ads.

faq.question: Does Product Metrics include earlier orders?
faq.answer: No. Lifetime value starts with orders Product Metrics observes after the store connects.

faq.question: When should I choose Revenue LTV instead of Profit LTV?
faq.answer: Choose Revenue LTV if your order costs are incomplete. Choose Profit LTV when costs are known and you want to optimize for profit.

faq.question: Does every channel receive the running total?
faq.answer: No. Each channel receives the per-order contribution. Meta also receives the running total when the customer's orders use one currency.

faq.question: Can the assistant switch my campaign to the new conversion?
faq.answer: No. You make the Google Ads action primary or select the optimization conversion in Meta or ChatGPT Ads.

faq.question: Do refunds affect revenue lifetime value?
faq.answer: Yes. Refunds lower revenue lifetime value, and canceled orders contribute nothing.
